title.zh: 美国土安全部下令将DeepSeek产品排除在联邦民用机构系统之外
title.en: DHS orders DeepSeek products removed from federal civilian agency systems

current_state.zh: The US Department of Homeland Security ordered DeepSeek products and related services removed from federal civilian agency IT systems, citing risks of sensitive data exposure to China and security vulnerabilities.
current_state.en: The US Department of Homeland Security ordered DeepSeek products and related services removed from federal civilian agency IT systems, citing risks of sensitive data exposure to China and security vulnerabilities.

updates.what_changed_zh: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security ordered DeepSeek and related products, including third-party services incorporating DeepSeek, to be excluded from federal civilian agency procurement and removed from their IT systems.
